title: feat(audit): a package uninstall writes one `package_uninstall` ledger row about the package itself
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiMUyQBfkxjbMPiRuAiJCX6U)_

Fixes #31186

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:卸载一个软件包后,审计日志里会多一条 `package_uninstall`(卸载软件包)记录,写明谁卸载的、哪个包、版本、所在环境、是否保留了数据表,以及删掉了几项元数据、有几项没删掉。所有卸载入口(Studio / `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id`、导入回滚、配对定制包安装撤销、cloud 侧直接调用卸载动词的工具)都会写,因为写入点在它们共同经过的卸载动词 `deletePackage` 里。
- 为什么改:此前卸载只留下逐条元数据的删除记录,包本身的那一行(`sys_packages`)是用原始 SQL 删的,不走钩子,所以「这个应用被谁卸载了」在审计日志里没有任何记录;一个没有存储元数据的包卸载后完全不留痕。
- 风险与回滚:只新增一条审计行,卸载的行为和返回内容都不变。审计行在包已删除、清理全部跑完之后才写;写失败只记一条 error 日志,卸载照常成功;没有审计插件的环境完全不受影响。被拒绝的卸载、以及不存在的包(404)都不写。这行不属于任何组织,只有平台管理员能看到。可整个 PR 回滚。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-uninstall.ts` 末尾 `return` 前的调用与 `readInstalledPackage`;`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/package-lifecycle-audit.ts` 的 `buildPackageLifecycleAuditRow`;`sys-audit-log.object.ts` 新增的 `package_uninstall` 选项。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/package-lifecycle-audit.test.ts`,预期 9 个用例全部通过,其中第二个用例从真实引擎读回整行,断言操作人、包、版本、环境都在。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

An uninstall left one `sys_audit_log` `delete` row per metadata item it removed (credited to the caller since #31023) and nothing about the package. `@objectstack/service-package` deletes the package's own `sys_packages` row with `DELETE FROM sys_packages WHERE id = ?` through `engine.execute`, which fires no hook, so no writer could ever see it. Measured at branch start on `main` 169ff7e5: the verb's body (`protocol-package-uninstall.ts`) makes no audit call, and the new verb and door pins below fail against it (the ablation section is that measurement).

Per the seat's ruling (an event writer in `plugin-audit` reached through the `audit` service slot, the #27908 pattern; uninstall only):

- **`@objectstack/plugin-audit`**: new `package-lifecycle-audit.ts`. `createPackageLifecycleAuditWriter` registers `recordPackageLifecycleEvent` on the `audit` slot beside `recordAuthEvent`, `recordActionInvocation` and `recordDataExport`. The caller hands over an event; this package owns the row:
  - `action: 'package_uninstall'`;
  - `actor` = the principal the verb was called for; `user_id` = the same value unless it is a `svc:` principal (no `sys_user` row carries one);
  - `object_name` / `record_id` null: `sys_packages` is not an object, so the row is about no record and the ledger's record gate serves it under the ledger's own grant (`ledgerRowAboutNoRecordWhere`);
  - `tenant_id` null: an uninstall is environment-wide (ADR-0131 D6/D12), so this is a deployment-level row, served to the platform administrator alone (#26750 ruling A). Pinned by adding the row to `audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts` (all three tenancy postures);
  - `metadata`: `package_id`, `version`, `environment_id`, `keep_data`, `items_removed`, `items_failed`, `outcome` (`complete` / `partial`).
  - Never throws; a refused insert is reported at `error` once per cause through a named callee (`persistPackageLifecycleAuditRow`), declared in `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` and `measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` the way `persistDataExportAuditRow` is.
  - `sys_audit_log.action` gains the `package_uninstall` option, writer-first, with its label and all ten translated locales; the writer is registered in `sys-audit-log-retired-actions.test.ts`'s `ACTIONS_WITH_WRITERS`.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `deletePackage` calls the slot once, after the cleanups and before it returns, so every caller of the verb is covered. Two reads feed it: the installed version, read from the registry right before the withdrawal releases it (beside `captureUninstallDeclared`, nothing near `assertPackageUninstallable` changes), and the protocol's `environmentId`, now handed to the moved body through its host. A refusal throws before the call, so it writes nothing; an id the registry did not hold and the store bound no metadata to writes nothing either (the door answers it `404`). No audit slot means no call. A slot that throws anyway is logged at `error` and never changes the answer.
- The tenant-audit census counts the writer's one new insert site (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and its counts file, regenerated with `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` plus the six hand-written figures the gate holds to it).

No `packages/spec` change.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/package-lifecycle-audit.test.ts` (new, 9 cases): on the real `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AuditPlugin` boot, through the `audit` slot, read back from the engine: the full row; a partial uninstall; absent actor / version / environment recorded as null; no row for an event naming no package or another action; a `svc:` actor never in `user_id`; a ledger without the `actor` column; no engine, no throw; a refused insert reported once at `error` and never thrown.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.package-delete-refusal.test.ts`, new top-level describe in the existing harness (9 cases): one event with package, version, environment, actor, `keepData` and counts, handed over after the cleanups; partial uninstall; CONTROLs: both store refusal channels, the registry's refusal and a retired request key hand over nothing; a non-installed id hands over nothing; no slot, the uninstall completes; a throwing slot does not change the answer.
- `packages/runtime/src/package-uninstall-store-refusal.integration.test.ts`, new top-level describe in the existing harness (4 cases, real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` + `PackageServicePlugin` + protocol + `HttpDispatcher`): `DELETE /packages/:id` hands the slot one event naming the signed-in user, the package, `1.0.0` and the environment; an in-process `protocol.deletePackage` call hands over the same event naming its actor; CONTROLs: a store-refused delete (500) and a non-installed id (404) hand over nothing.
- `audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts`: the `package_uninstall` row joins the deployment-level fixture rows; served to the platform administrator, to no organization reader, in all three postures.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time, scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

The call in `deletePackage` was replaced by a no-op with the same arguments (marker `_ablate31186`), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirmed the marker in `dist/`. Result: `protocol.package-delete-refusal.test.ts` 4 failed / 16 passed (the four positive #31186 cases), `package-uninstall-store-refusal.integration.test.ts` 2 failed / 9 passed (the HTTP door case and the in-process case). Every CONTROL stayed green. Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (2b053d2b9555) and git diff HEAD is empty`, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, both files green again (20/20, 11/11).

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: Test Files 77 passed, Tests 1212 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 324 passed / 4 skipped, Tests 22545 passed / 26 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/package-uninstall-store-refusal.integration.test.ts`: 11 passed (only this runtime file changed; the runtime suite runs in CI).
- `pnpm --filter <pkg> typecheck` for plugin-audit, metadata-protocol and runtime: exit 0 each.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Uncovered path, declared:** install-local's uninstall door (`handleUninstall` in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`) does not go through `deletePackage`: it removes its marketplace ledger entry, withdraws the package from the registry and calls `protocol.runUninstallCleanups` directly, so it writes no `package_uninstall` row. Per the seat's ruling no second call site is added here; the seat files it.
- Install, enable and disable would fit the same writer (a closed `PackageLifecycleAuditAction` union and the same event shape); none is built.
- The cleanup-registration route (`registerUninstallCleanup`) was weighed and not taken (seat ruling A): cleanups run for every id including a non-installed one, run after the registry released the version, carry no environment or `keepData`, and their outcomes ride on the `DELETE` answer's `cleanups[]`.

## Verification

Measured on head `99f0fba08` (branch merged with `origin/main` ea62933c2):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 119 gate commands derived for this change set; all 119 run, every one `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: 119 derived, 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The package suites, the three typechecks and `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 25 touched `.ts` / `.mjs` files, each `exit 0`, on the same head.
- The full command list with exit codes is in the os-dev-report comment on #31186.
